## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**

DIVERGENCE: Major short-term vs 1M mismatches in core risk ETFs (SPY, XLK, QQQ in CORRECTION) create MAJOR divergence → market remains transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposures (XLE, XME, ITA) and monitor credit via HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +1.01%) vs LQD (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%); reduce exposure to tech momentum names while watching VXX (1W: +2.60% | 1M: -10.53%) for renewed volatility.
